# Glammzo

> Glammzo is an online salon booking marketplace in India. Customers find salons near them, compare fixed prices and ratings, and book hair, beauty, spa, and nail appointments online — starting in Bengaluru (Bangalore).

## Key facts
- Product: Online salon and beauty appointment booking
- Geography: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India (expanding)
- Website: https://glammzo.com
- Contact: support@glammzo.com
- Company: Fixxzo Technologies Private Limited

## Best pages for Bengaluru salon search
- https://glammzo.com/get-999-off — get ₹999 off, every 10th service free
- https://glammzo.com/salons-in/bengaluru — salons in Bengaluru
- https://glammzo.com/hair-salon-in-bengaluru — hair salon in Bengaluru
- https://glammzo.com/spa-in-bengaluru — spa in Bengaluru
- https://glammzo.com/nail-salon-in-bengaluru — nail salon in Bengaluru
- https://glammzo.com/beauty-parlour-in-bengaluru — beauty parlour in Bengaluru
- https://glammzo.com/best-salons-in-bengaluru — best salons in Bengaluru
- https://glammzo.com/salons-near-me — salon near me hub
- https://glammzo.com/explore — browse and filter salons

## How booking works
1. Choose location (Near me or Bengaluru neighbourhood)
2. Compare salons, services, and fixed prices
3. Book a slot online and track it in your account

## Optional
- Partner salons manage availability in Glamzzo CRM
- Customer WhatsApp / in-app updates follow booking status rules
